entrypoints.summary: A fork pull request can alter the chart-version script and arrange for Image CI Build to complete successfully, which triggers Chart CI Push through workflow_run.
The workflow_run handler selects the triggering fork head SHA as the checkout ref when the head repository is a fork.

affected_components.role: Vulnerable workflow resolves a fork ref, checks it out, executes its local version script, and uses registry credentials for the push action.
Remediation runs version logic from the default branch and limits feature checkout to chart content.
symbols: Copy default branch chart version script

code_slices.fixed: The patch copies print-chart-version.sh and VERSION from the default-branch checkout and evaluates ../cilium-default-branch/contrib/scripts/print-chart-version.sh.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The vulnerable workflow supplies QUAY_CHARTS_DEV_USERNAME and QUAY_CHARTS_DEV_PASSWORD to the push-helm-chart action; the patch splits setup and push jobs and sparse-checks out feature chart content.
code_slices.vulnerable: The workflow assigns workflow_run.head_sha to the ref for fork runs, checks out that ref, then evaluates ./contrib/scripts/print-chart-version.sh for chart_version.

negative_controls: No workflow-run log or execution transcript is retained in this bundle.
No observed secret-access or exfiltration output is retained in this bundle.
observability.positive_marker: The advisory says completion of the pull-request Image CI Build triggers the vulnerable Chart CI Push workflow, whose Get version step invokes the altered script.

preconditions: An attacker can submit a fork pull request that changes the repository-local chart-version script.
The attacker can cause the named upstream Image CI Build workflow to complete successfully, as in the advisory's documented reproduction.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A fork PR changes contrib/scripts/print-chart-version.sh; the advisory gives echo $(whoami) as a benign example and modifies build-images-ci.yaml to complete successfully.
trigger_steps.summary: Modify the repository-local chart-version script and arrange a successful pull-request Image CI Build so the workflow_run handler starts Chart CI Push.

impact.attacker_capability: Execute attacker-supplied shell commands through a repository-local script in the workflow_run-triggered job, then access or extract the named registry secrets as described by the advisory.
impact.security_effect: Potential exfiltration of registry credentials from the privileged Chart CI Push job.

causal_trace.summary: A fork-originated pull request supplies an attacker-controlled head SHA and may change contrib/scripts/print-chart-version.sh while causing the named upstream build workflow to complete.
The post-workflow chart-push job resolves the fork head SHA as its ref and checks out that untrusted tree, so executable repository-local workflow logic is not confined to a trusted base revision.
After the untrusted checkout, the Get version step evaluates ./contrib/scripts/print-chart-version.sh in command substitution to construct chart_version.

The advisory states that attacker-controlled code in this job can exfiltrate QUAY_CHARTS_DEV_USERNAME and QUAY_CHARTS_DEV_PASSWORD; the workflow source passes those secrets to the chart-push action as registry credentials.

failure.operation: Shell command substitution invoking ./contrib/scripts/print-chart-version.sh after checkout of the triggering ref

primary_invariant.statement: Repository-local scripts executed by the post-workflow chart-push job must originate from a trusted base revision rather than the triggering fork pull request checkout.
primary_invariant.violated_because: For a fork workflow_run, the workflow checks out workflow_run.head_sha and subsequently invokes the checked-out contrib/scripts/print-chart-version.sh.

quality.review_notes: The advisory gives a concrete fork/PR reproduction sequence and a benign whoami payload, but this bundle contains no retained Actions run log, live execution transcript, or test result. Secret-exfiltration capability is advisory-backed and corroborated by the workflow's registry-secret inputs, not by an observed run in the bundle. The separate cache-poisoning issue is intentionally excluded because its write/restore dataflow is not independently established here.

remediation.invariant_restored: The patch copies the chart-version script and VERSION from a default-branch checkout and executes that trusted copy; the later feature checkout is limited to install/kubernetes/cilium while the chart-push job retains trusted action definitions.
mitigation_classes: separation of untrusted chart content from executable workflow logic
